subject: Evaluation plan & timeline for Redwood pilot (proposed roles + next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery North <avery.north@finovate.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation plan & timeline for Redwood pilot (proposed roles + next steps)

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Based on what we discussed, I put together a short evaluation plan and proposed timeline so we can align stakeholders and avoid surprises during the POC. I attached a lightweight MAP template and an initial SOW draft to get the procurement ball rolling.

High-level goals (please confirm / edit):
- Prove parity on latency and throughput for our 512-token baseline across a typical transaction mix
- Validate integration with your event pipeline (Kafka) and that KV cache persists across restarts
- Measure cost per 1k tokens and recommend quantization profile for production

Proposed roles (suggested):
- Customer champion: Avery North — overall decision owner & primary contact
- Technical lead (customer): Joanna Park — owns integration + test harness
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole — program owner, weekly syncs, escalation
- Redwood SE: Dylan Brooks — technical onboarding, runbooks, acceptance criteria
- Procurement / Legal: procurement@finovate.com — contract + payment terms

Proposed timeline: 6 weeks total
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment access (this week)
- Weeks 1–3: Integration + sample dataset runs
- Week 4: Load/latency validation + tuning
- Week 5: Acceptance tests and evaluation report
- Week 6: Close / contract execution or next steps

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the champion and the technical lead above?
2) Are there any hard blackout dates in March we should avoid for the big integration/validation windows?
3) Are you comfortable with the proposed 6-week cadence, or would you prefer a compressed 4-week trial?

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for an initial 60-minute kickoff to walk through success criteria and milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Finovate_MAP_Template.xlsx, SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and for pulling the template together. Confirming I will be the product champion and Joanna (cc’d) will be the technical lead. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We have a scheduled code freeze the week of Mar 16–20, so heavy integration during that week is risky.
- For business reasons we need a contract in place by the end of April; the 6-week plan is workable as long as we start this week.
- Procurement will expect an initial SOW and a one-page SLA addendum (I’ll loop them in after we pick dates).

Joanna — would you be able to join a kickoff tomorrow or Friday morning for the technical deep-dive? If not, next Monday morning works for us.
